objective.pass_effect: does not approve E0 or any later stage

split.algorithm: build the undirected player interaction graph from F0-D0 manifest membership only; sort connected components by descending game count then component identity; assign each component to the partition minimizing post-assignment game load divided by its target load, with canonical SHA-256 as the tie break
split.cross_player_conflict_rule: all games and players in the connected component receive the component partition
required_invariants: one player key occurs in exactly one partition
one behavior game occurs in exactly one partition
both players of a game share its partition
protected raw records are not opened

cost.pilot_unit: whole train game with deterministically selected predecessor states
cost.projection_estimator: upper 95 percent normal bound for mean queries and seconds per state multiplied by eligible logical plies
cost.sample_rule: rank all train and selection session IDs by canonical SHA-256 of namespace, seed, and session ID; take the first 8192 whole games

support.behavior_class: phase, actor color, on-board counts, unplaced counts, and legal-action-count bucket
support.unsupported_policy: abstain; never inherit a global probability

reachability.safe_set: all legal moves preserving the best positional Malom WDL tier

mechanism_bound.event: first positional theory downgrade in a game
mechanism_bound.steerable: the immediately preceding human move preserved its parent WDL tier, had A_pos cardinality greater than one, and belonged to a supported preregistered behavior class
mechanism_bound.within_tier_full_comparator_regret: secondary only and never merged with WDL loss

product_bound.upper_bound: fraction of factual games with a supported steerable predecessor; maximum score swing is one point per such game

interval.method: envelope of fixed-membership Wilson and player-network connected-component cluster-robust normal 95 percent intervals
interval.insufficient_components: if fewer than two components, return [0,1] and fail dependence gates
interval.interpretation: fixed source-domain engineering interval, not population inference

product_effect.unit: average match-score points per natural source-domain game
product_effect.gate: reject when the conservative factual upper 95 percent bound is below 0.01
product_effect.rationale: one percentage point is the smallest product effect signed before observing F0-H0 statistics; this is a rejection threshold, not a release threshold

decision_rule.触发停止条件: one or more preregistered gates is false
